title: ezcap endpoint descriptor
description: Structured description of an observable surface produced by a driver or first-party code. Validated before reaching the specgen subsystem.

namespace.description: Owning driver name or first-party namespace.

metadata_only.description: Must be true for any endpoint that could carry observed data. Descriptors with metadata_only=false are rejected unless the endpoint is purely synthetic (documentation markers), which the daemon never produces from observed data.

attribution.description: Attribution policy notes carried into generated specs.

confidence.description: Confidence semantics for stream/event endpoints, e.g. 'correlated: 0.40-0.69 probable'.

privacy.description: Field-level annotations identifying data subject to redaction.

schemaSubset.description: JSON Schema subset accepted for request/response shapes. Intentionally narrow: no $ref, no external URIs, bounded depth and size.
